# Dualrec

> Dualrec is a free, open-source screen and webcam recorder for Windows 10 and 11. One recording produces four separate, synced files: screen.mp4, camera.mp4, mic.m4a and system.m4a (H.264 video, AAC audio), so the camera and each audio source can be edited independently. No account, no watermark, no time limit; it records offline and the files stay on the user's computer.

Key facts:

- Platform: Windows 10 and 11. There is no Mac version yet (planned).
- Price: free. Source code is public on GitHub.
- Output: one folder per recording under `Videos\Dualrec`, with `screen.mp4` (a full screen or a single window), `camera.mp4` (webcam at full resolution), `mic.m4a` (microphone) and `system.m4a` (system audio). All tracks start at the same instant and have the same length, so they line up when placed at the start of an editor timeline.
- Features: floating camera bubble that is left out of the screen recording, live preview of the selected screen, pause that keeps all tracks in sync, global shortcuts (Ctrl+Alt+R to start/stop, Ctrl+Alt+P to pause), hardware H.264 encoding on NVIDIA, Intel and AMD with a CPU fallback.
- Each source (screen, camera, microphone, system audio) can be turned on or off independently.
- The app interface is in Spanish for now. The website is available in Spanish and English.
- The installer is about 30 MB and is not code-signed yet: Windows SmartScreen may ask the user to choose "More info" and then "Run anyway".
- Files can be edited afterwards in any video editor (DaVinci Resolve, Premiere, CapCut, etc.).
- AI editing (since 0.1.2): Dualrec includes a local MCP server for Claude (`dualrec.exe --mcp`, connected with one button from the app). Its tools list recordings, detect speech and silences, return still frames of screen and camera, and export finished MP4s on the user's computer: horizontal 1920x1080, vertical 1080x1920 or square, with picture-in-picture, stacked or side-by-side layouts, screen zoom, silence removal, a title and burned-in captions. It does not transcribe audio yet.
- Made by Malka Digital, a custom software studio.

## Guides (English)

- [How to record your screen and webcam as separate files on Windows](https://dualrec.malkadigital.com/en/blog/record-screen-and-webcam-separately-windows/): step-by-step setup and recording guide
- [Why recording separate tracks makes editing easier](https://dualrec.malkadigital.com/en/blog/why-record-separate-tracks/): moving or hiding the camera, cleaning up the voice, horizontal and vertical versions
- [How to make vertical Shorts, Reels and TikToks from a screen recording](https://dualrec.malkadigital.com/en/blog/vertical-shorts-reels-tiktok-from-screen-recording/): building 9:16 videos from separate screen and camera files
- [Make videos and Reels with AI: Dualrec connected to Claude](https://dualrec.malkadigital.com/en/blog/edit-videos-with-claude-ai-mcp/): the MCP connector, how to connect it and what to ask for
